jobs.title: Overseas Operations Manager (P2P)
jobs.jd_full:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Overseas Operations Manager (P2P) to drive strategic growth and operational excellence across key overseas markets.

This role requires deep understanding of P2P market mechanics, merchant ecosystem dynamics, regional payment infrastructures, and competitive positioning. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience operating P2P markets at leading exchanges (e.g., Binance, Bybit, Bitget) and can independently formulate expansion strategies while delivering measurable growth outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Market Expansion & Growth Strategy

  • Develop and implement regional P2P expansion strategies to ensure sustainable and stable business growth

  • Monitor regional regulatory developments and assess their impact on P2P business models

  • Continuously adjust market strategy based on competitive landscape and market shifts

  1. P2P Merchant & Ecosystem Management

  • Design and optimize advertiser (merchant) onboarding, segmentation, and incentive structures

  • Maintain close engagement with key merchants to ensure liquidity depth and spread competitiveness

  • Improve completion rate, trading efficiency, and dispute resolution performance

  • Develop structured management frameworks for regional merchant operations

  1. Operational Optimization & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to enhance P2P transaction workflows and feature design

  • Provide structured feedback on product gaps, user pain points, and regional behavioral differences

  • Improve end-to-end operational efficiency, including order flow, payment processing, and dispute handling

  1. Data Monitoring & Competitive Intelligence

  • Monitor core P2P KPIs (volume, active users, merchant depth, spreads, completion rate, dispute rate)

  • Conduct in-depth data analysis and anomaly detection to identify growth bottlenecks and risk patterns

  • Track competitor strategies (pricing, incentives, merchant policies, risk models) and propose strategic responses

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in platform operations; crypto / Web3 experience strongly preferred

  • Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on P2P operations experience in overseas markets (outside Mainland China)

  • Experience at major exchanges

  • Strong understanding of:

    • P2P liquidity dynamics and spread formation

    • Regional payment systems (bank transfers, local e-wallets, alternative rails)

  • Proven ability to adapt operational strategy based on market and competitive changes

  • Strong analytical skills with data-driven decision-making capability

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills

  • Fluent in English; Chinese or other regional languages are a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing regional teams, community contributors, or local operators

  • Strong understanding of overseas P2P fraud patterns and payment risks

  • Ability to independently articulate structural differences between regional P2P markets

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Lending
jobs.jd_full:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Fintech team is responsible for a diverse range of products and workstreams, all with the united goal of helping restaurants make dealing with money easier. From quickly and seamlessly taking guest payments to extending credit via our lending products, the Fintech product team tackles some of the biggest and most impactful initiatives within Toast.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Toast’s Lending efforts as part of our Embedded Finance team. You will be responsible for identifying, prioritizing and building innovative financial products & features that help restaurant owners access the funding they need to start, run or grow their business. The initiatives you spearhead will expand and strengthen our suite of lending products like Toast Capital and Easy Pay, growing our reach and impact.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

In this role, you will interface with our restaurant customers directly to get feedback on product opportunities in order to inspire and inform how Toast continues to iterate and deliver more value. You will own the Lending product roadmap and collaborate with various teams across Toast, most notably Credit, Capital Markets, Legal & Compliance, Data Science/ AI, Marketing, Operations, Payments, Finance. You will also engage external bank partners, funding partners and various vendors.

  • Own the product roadmap for Toast Capital (Toast’s flagship lending product).
  • Work closely with cross functional teams and various product domains across Toast to support ideation, design, development, launch and support of new and existing products.
  • Create & present business cases and business models for new product investments, and measure/quantify success of product launches.
  • Write technical and non-technical user stories, define requirements, workflows, and wireframes in collaboration with Engineering, Design, Data Science and other teams.
  • Manage the backlog of an established engineering team, define roadmap requirements, and facilitate agile ceremonies.
  • Communicate and collaborate with technical counterparts, and business-oriented stakeholders, to consistently set and meet expectations.

What you’ll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of driving strategy, execution, and impact for B2B products
  • A passion for innovating in financial services and desire to transform the restaurant & hospitality industry
  • Experience managing products from their early inception to measurable post-launch success.
  • A track record of strong execution, delivering speed and quality.
  • Versatile skillet - you’re able to design innovative financial products, experiment to deliver top notch personalized user experiences, drive consistent risk model improvements, build efficient risk and operations tooling, and develop a scalable platform.
  • Strong written & verbal communication skills, with an emphasis on communicating roadmaps, tradeoffs and technical solutions to a variety of stakeholders.
  • High EQ and is skilled at building and maintaining relationships with engineering & design teams.
  • Strong ability to turn data into actionable insights and customer outcomes
  • Proven ability to influence across teams and drive alignment in ambiguous, high-impact spaces
  • Comfortable with data analysis tools like SQL.

Bonus ingredients*

  • First-hand experience with lending.
  • Experience working fast-growing teams & hyper-growth companies.
  • Experience delivering products powered by machine learning models.
  • Experience incorporating legal & regulatory oversight into consumer or business products.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we’re hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A

$159,000—$254,000 USD

Zone B

$138,000—$221,000 USD

Zone C

$125,000—$200,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. jobs.title: Associate Technical Project Manager

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.

About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

About the Role

We are hiring a Group Product Manager to lead and develop PMs working across Onebrief and AtomEngine. You will help shape product direction, turn customer insight into clear priorities, and build a team that makes strong decisions independently.

Your impact will come through the people you develop and the products they build. You will coach experienced PMs, improve decisions across product areas, and work with Engineering and Design to turn ambitious ideas into useful, dependable software. You will stay close to customers and difficult product questions while giving PMs clear ownership of their areas.

You will also help shape product management for an agentic future. As AI agents take on more of the work of building software, you will help the team strengthen the customer understanding, problem framing, and evaluation that guide that work. You will partner with company leadership on direction and consequential tradeoffs, and own priorities and outcomes within your team’s agreed scope.

About You

Experienced PMs seek your input because it makes their thinking better. You have built complex software yourself and can translate that experience into useful coaching. You know when to ask a better question, when to give direct feedback, and when to make a decision.

You bring ambition and intellectual honesty to the work. You can hold a high bar while giving people room to grow. You care enough about customers to learn how they actually work, and you take responsibility for what happens after a product ships.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop strong product leaders. Set clear expectations, coach through live work, address performance gaps, and support hiring and growth. Help PMs develop the judgment and confidence to lead increasingly difficult work.

  • Shape coherent product direction. Connect company priorities and customer needs to a clear point of view across your product areas. Make deliberate choices about what to pursue, sequence, test, or defer.

  • Deepen customer understanding. Work with users, domain experts, and field teams to understand operational workflows. Help PMs distinguish recurring needs from individual requests and find opportunities customers may struggle to articulate.

  • Advance product management with AI agents. Partner with Engineering and Design to test new approaches to discovery and development. Equip PMs to provide agents with useful context, define success, evaluate results, and exercise judgment where it matters.

  • Raise product quality. Help teams make sophisticated capabilities understandable and dependable. Challenge assumptions, review alternatives, and balance experimentation with the trust customers place in our software.

  • Build commitment across teams. Resolve dependencies and competing priorities with Engineering, Design, and Product Operations. Clarify ownership and bring larger tradeoffs to leadership with a recommendation.

  • Follow through on outcomes. Define success before delivery and learn from adoption, customer feedback, and business results. Change course when the evidence shows that a different approach would create more value.

What We Look For

  • Direct experience managing product managers, including developing experienced PMs, giving difficult feedback, and improving performance.

  • A record of shaping and delivering complex software products, with clear examples of customer or business impact.

  • Strong product judgment across discovery, strategy, prioritization, and evaluation after launch.

  • Technical fluency that earns the trust of Engineering and enables thoughtful tradeoffs with Design.

  • Experience leading across multiple teams and communicating consequential decisions clearly.

  • Practical curiosity about AI agents and how they can improve product development, paired with thoughtful evaluation of their limits.

Experience with defense customers, planning tools, simulation, or other demanding enterprise workflows is valuable. We welcome candidates from adjacent industries who bring strong product leadership and a commitment to learning from users.

Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies

Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

Our GTM Program Management team turns commercial priorities into programs that ship, and into results the business can measure. You will own the plan, the cadence, and the follow-through across Commercial functions, including: RevOps, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Hi, I’m Geo, Ashby’s VP of Product. I joined Ashby August ‘26; read more about why I joined here. I’m hiring for multiple Product Managers who will report directly to me. More on the specific product areas below.

At Ashby, we have a unique approach to building products. As a PM, your primary goal is to eliminate frustration and bring delight to our customers. You’ll work with engineers who deeply understand the customer and business problem and own the solution end-to-end. This means that you spend less time writing detailed specs and more time with customers and doing deep product thinking.

Our unique approach is working. We’re growing >100% year over year and have notable customers such as Notion, Linear, OpenAI, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best in class among our peers. We’re backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more!

Product Areas

From day one, we have aimed to build “all-in-one and best-in-class” software for Talent teams. In addition to building a multi-product foundation from day one, we have also focused on enabling customizability and power-user features while keeping Ashby easy to get started with. Doing both is an ambitious undertaking!

We want to continue down this ambitious path in future and add multiple new products, which means we:

  • Are not just building a product, we’re building a platform

  • Need to find a balance between re-usable building blocks and feature-specific behaviour

  • Blend enterprise customizability and ease of use

We also want to continuously delight users. We hear “I never thought one could fall in love with an ATS” quite often, and we want to keep that true for all future products we build.

We are looking for Product Managers who can own the roadmap and strategy for the following areas:

  1. Outbound Sourcing: You’ll build a platform that enables teams to hire sourcing agents directly from Ashby. Customers simply write the job description, and agents start booking calls with highly qualified candidates.

  2. Product Platform: Ashby was designed from the beginning as a multi-product platform. We’re looking for a PM to establish this team and own the shared building blocks, foundational capabilities, and APIs that let product teams move quickly.

  3. AI Platform: You’ll own the Ashby Assistant, Ashby MCP, and the AI platform used across many product surfaces. You’ll help drive shared primitives, such as AI memory and context.

During the interview process, we’ll determine which role you’re best suited for. We’re also advertising this opening as Staff Product Manager. Both titles describe the same position; please apply once using the title that best reflects your experience.

Your Role

  • Drive Impact: Deeply understand our customers and ship impactful product improvements and investments to maintain our strong velocity.

  • Quality: Apply your strong product taste and sound judgement to deliver solutions that are both powerful and a joy to use. Use your judgment to identify areas where we need to improve quality before shipping.

  • Prioritization and Strategy: Maintain a roadmap to ensure engineering is never blocked, and set a compelling strategy and vision for the next 6-18 months.

  • Customer Research: Spend time with customers and customer-facing teams. Synthesize customer feedback, research, and competitive intel to drive smart prioritization choices.

  • Execution Excellence: Set the pace for your product area by identifying bottlenecks, scoping effectively, and driving projects toward high-impact releases. Stay close to engineering work to navigate tradeoffs, manage technical risks, and resolve execution challenges.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner across go-to-market teams to bring the features and products your team builds to the market. Anticipate and plan for the needs to help inform pricing, marketing, and customer support.

  • Ownership and reliability: follow through on commitments, manage time ruthlessly, respond promptly to stakeholders, and communicate proactively when priorities or timelines change.

You could be a great fit if

  • You have an unnatural curiosity and excitement about the end-user and the jobs they do

  • You bring an Engineering mindset to product problems and can think through edge cases and understand how to extend our underlying platform to create leverage

  • You can demonstrate taste - you care about the quality of the products you build and use

  • You’re an excellent writer and synthesizer; you bring product knowledge and clarity to the entire organization and enable Engineers with product insights

  • You can build a thesis for prioritization and communicate priorities using a sound strategy that combines principled thinking, research, and data

  • You leverage tools and processes to build operational excellence into your product process

  • You have a strong business sense and understand how product and GTM should collaborate, how your features may be monetized, and how product priorities fit into larger business priorities

You may not be a great fit if

  • You prefer to specify exactly what Engineering should build rather than give engineers room to own the solution.

  • You dislike written documentation and prefer to manage the team via meetings and quick Slack messages.

  • You’re primarily interested in shipping features and not thinking through how to make them reusable platform capabilities.

  • You don’t enjoy doing deep research yourself and prefer to outsource that UX research, market research, and data teams.

  • You’re uncomfortable moving with urgency, making tradeoffs, and reprioritizing when new information emerges.

  • You’re primarily motivated by achieving a metric more than delivering a great product experience for customers.

We Work Differently

At Ashby, the role of Product Managers is different from what I’ve seen in most product orgs. At a high level, PMs are responsible for shipping impactful product changes at high velocity, consistently and over an extended period. When we think about impactful product changes, our primary goal is to remove frustration and add delight.

At many organizations, PMs are required to write detailed specs that handle every edge case. Designers are required to mock up every pixel. At Ashby, it’s different. We believe individual contributors do their best work when they have a deep understanding of the end user and the business, and ownership of the solution. This is reflected in the engineers Ashby hires: they own projects end-to-end and deeply understand the problems they are solving. PMs are expected to give significant white space in their specs. As a result, PMs can spend less time managing tickets and more time with customers and thinking deeply about the product strategy.

At Ashby, PMs need to be the pace-setters for their product areas. This means they bring a healthy level of impatience and time-paranoia to the table. This does not mean cutting corners or demanding that engineers work unreasonable hours. As a PM, you can help engineers by managing the project scope well, identifying when it’s appropriate to bring in help, or being ruthless about prioritization.

For PM roles at Ashby, we believe great products are built through deep thinking and a clear understanding of user needs. A major part of your role involves conducting thorough user research to uncover underlying customer problems and translating those insights into well-reasoned product strategies.

Finally, Ashby isn’t simply an ATS. Right from the foundations, it was designed to be much more than that. It’s a platform modelled around how organizations (from early-stage startups to massive enterprises) think about recruiting, managing, and retaining top talent. As a PM at Ashby, you should, over time, get familiar with our most common building blocks. You’ll invest not only in product improvements but in platform thinking.

Interview Process

If this also sounds exciting to you, please apply. We review every application and aim to get back to candidates within 2-3 days. For candidates that advance to the interview process, here is what you can expect:

  1. Intro Cal l - 30 mins

  2. Product Experience Deep Dive- 45 mins

  3. Product Exercise - 1 hour

  4. Final Round Interview - 2 hours

Mostly focused on cross-functional Interviews to meet more of the team. This is a critical hire for us and a role that will touch a lot of functions - we want to make sure you’ll meet folks you’ll be working closely with

Benefits

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.

  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • $250/month tool budget plus access to Claude, Cursor, and Codex with generous token budgets.

  • If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, which is also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
